address: 34/36 Mu 4, Bo Phut, Ko Samui, 84320, Thailand
bio: Just 5 minutes from the airport, Khao Horm is a great spot to get your last-minute fill of delicious Southern Thai and local recipes before flying home. The family recipes have been passed down from generation to generation for over a century. We recommend the stir-fried minced pork whose yellow curry paste features a gutsy mix of spices. The main dining room is set in a large open-air pavilion. They also offer AC indoor dining and plenty of parking too....
